description: Check if a trucking company is legally authorized to operate and has valid insurance. Returns operating authority status (common, contract, broker - active/inactive/revoked), BIPD insurance, cargo insurance, bond/surety status, and whether they're allowed to haul freight. Use this for questions like 'can this carrier legally operate?', 'do they have insurance?', 'is this broker licensed?', 'verify carrier authority', 'check trucking company credentials', 'is this freight company legit?', or any carrier compliance check.
name: fmcsa_carrier_authority
